verdict.rationale: Omnirush is a desktop coding-agent app with a web console, so issuing scoped agent credentials is a fair question for it. The evidence shows no way to mint scoped or least-privilege API credentials. Device-code login, bring-your-own provider keys, and per-session tool-call permission prompts are adjacent features, not scoped credential issuance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
